scope: Indexable enterprise filters, scoped template-PK lookups for label filtering, full template joins only after overview pagination, publication statistics aggregated once per overview page.
Two additive indexes for creation-time ordering and operator-filtered creation-time ordering; no business-row changes.
Native MySQL JSON objects and historical LONGTEXT JSON both parse correctly, preserving manual empty image selections and shop-copy details.
Optional frozen template payloads with an official category-definition version, private enterprise master version, one-level patch and inline list projections.

rollout.default: empty: all writers retain legacy template payloads
rollout.opt_in_format: comma-separated enterprise storage IDs, for example admin,2
rollout.public_definition_source: Only whitelisted fields from ozon_category_attributes; not product payloads or caller-provided text.
ordering: Install and validate the additive schemas.
Deploy compatible readers to all active primary/candidate instances while the write setting stays empty.
Verify normal workflows and rollback-reader compatibility, then opt in the internal enterprise explicitly.
Expand to customer enterprises only after their own workflow acceptance.
rollout.rollback_constraint: Turning the write setting off stops creating new references; it does not unfold references already saved. A rollback build must retain compatible readers, or an explicitly reviewed CAS-protected expansion of the affected rows must run before reverting to an older reader.
rollout.readiness: An invalid enterprise opt-in list, missing required table, non-InnoDB engine, mismatched non-null columns/hash collation, incorrect scoped primary key or any unexpected additional unique key prevents /api/ready from accepting the candidate. Ordinary nonunique indexes remain allowed. Default-off legacy reads permit an absent new table.
rollout.no_gc: There is no delete/GC operation for frozen versions. Deleting a mutable template or one draft never deletes its immutable version.

inline_projections: images_manually_edited and image_edit_intent for variant image authority
variant array length and stable variant identity
Frozen category name, local template name and category ID for display/search even after the live template changes or is deleted
compatibility_boundary.envelope_format: The reserved _listing_frozen_content_v1 marker is serialized as the first key in the LONGTEXT envelope. List metadata SQL checks that fixed 30-character prefix, avoiding JSON parsing of large legacy snapshots before choosing the label source.
full_assembly: Draft detail and full development-review rows
Source draft ownership/snapshot checks and AI fission inheritance
Publish payload construction, immutable submit snapshots and variant-link CAS
Template-dependent repair and scoped media/color maintenance
compatibility_boundary.legacy_policy: Unmarked legacy payloads are returned without reading the new table. Missing, foreign, damaged or projection-inconsistent marked versions fail explicitly; they never fall back to mutable templates or historical images.
compatibility_boundary.remaining_duplication: This slice does not shrink manual_facts_json or ai_payload_json. Their direct SQL readers and history projections retain the old representation. It does not migrate or clear historical payloads.

direct_json_consumers.semantics: Overview images/prices, source locks, full edit/fission/publish assembly, variant-ID CAS and repair tools.
Generated ai_variant_source_key from manual/AI source-product paths; unchanged manual/AI fields preserve it.
JSON_TABLE of source/job/workflow/image status/target; these determine actual generated-model history, not just planned targets.
asset_variant_id import idempotence and matrix draft writers; legacy writes remain readable.
Variant array length for SKU counts; inline arrays preserve this query.
Template/editable/manual variant array lengths for task coverage; inline arrays and unchanged manual fields preserve this query.
Full title, description, attributes and template source facts; aiWorkflowService source loader now scopes ownership and assembles frozen rows first.

measurement.source: isolated synthetic MySQL; no production access or real Ozon/AI calls
measurement.method: One warm-up and three measured runs for both old and new SQL; compare medians, IDs, totals and publication statistics. Normalization/media mapping are substitutes, not HTTP/browser latency.
measurement.limits: Default-enterprise all-draft queries and category-contains queries did not materially improve; category queries without the new indexes regressed in this fixture. Ship the query/index changes together. These numbers cover local SQL only, not page loading or production/multi-user capacity, and local timings vary.

frozen_payload_example.excludes: Private master storage, manual/AI facts, indexes, real production data and media bytes.

tests: Protected listing editor, template-health, media authority and draft-save tests
